00073 #if !defined(UGEN_VFP) && !defined(UGEN_NEON) && !defined(UGEN_VDSP)
00074 void MixUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00075 {
00076  int channel = 0;
00077  
00078  bool shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00079  bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal; 
00080  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00081  float* const outputSamplesBase = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00082  const float* channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00083  
00084  float* outputSamples = outputSamplesBase;
00085  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00086  {
00087   *outputSamples++ = *channelSamples++;
00088  }
00089  
00090  channel++;
00091   
00092  int numChannels = inputs->getNumChannels();
00093  
00094  for(/* leave channel value alone */; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00095  {
00096   shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00097   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00098   outputSamples = outputSamplesBase;
00099   const float* channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00100     
00101   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00102   {
00103    *outputSamples++ += *channelSamples++;
00104   }
00105  }
00106  
00107 }
00108 #endif

00168 #if !defined(UGEN_VFP) && !defined(UGEN_NEON) && !defined(UGEN_VDSP)
00169 void MixArrayUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00170 { 
00171  bool shouldDeleteLocal;
00172  bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal; 
00173  int numOutputChannels = getNumChannels();
00174  int blockSizeBytes = uGenOutput.getBlockSize() * sizeof(float);
00175  const int arraySize = arrayRef.size();
00176  
00177  for(int channel = 0; channel < numOutputChannels; channel++)
00178  {
00179   float * const outputSamplesBase = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00180   memset(outputSamplesBase, 0, blockSizeBytes);
00181 
00182   for(int arrayIndex = 0; arrayIndex < arraySize; arrayIndex++)
00183   {
00184    shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00185    int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00186    float* outputSamples = outputSamplesBase;//proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00187    const float* channelSamples = arrayRef[arrayIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00188          
00189    for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)
00190    {
00191     outputSamples[i] += channelSamples[i];
00192    }
00193   }
00194  }
00195 }
00196 #endif

00239 void Mix::constructMixArrayWithProxies(MixArrayUGenInternal* internal)
00240 {
00241  int numProxies = internal->getNumProxies();
00242  initInternal(numProxies + 1);
00243  
00244  internalUGens[0] = internal;
00245  internalUGens[0]->initValue(internal->getValue(0));
00246  
00247  if(numProxies > 0)
00248  {
00249   for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies; i++)
00250   {
00251    internalUGens[i] = internal->getProxy(i);
00252    internalUGens[i]->initValue(internal->getValue(i));
00253   }
00254  } 
00255 }
